_about: Frozen fixtures for native-dep-mirror.py — each case carries a representative issue body, the native blocked-by set to diff against, and the expected (eligible, to_add, drift) mirror plan per the A3.5 / Model A contract. Self-contained (no live issue numbers are a durable contract); the numbers are illustrative edge identifiers, not corpus references.

cases.name: real-format-225-shaped-blocks-not-mirrored
cases._note: #662 BLOCKER exemplar — the live #225 body shape. 'Blocks: #213' is the RECIPROCAL (current blocks #213, NOT blocked-by #213); the defect mirrored it as blocked-by(225<-213), inverting the edge. 'Relates to:' targets are non-blocking. Nothing is mirror-eligible; to_add MUST be empty so no false native dependency is written.
cases.body:
## Dependencies

Blocked by: — (independently shippable). · Blocks: **#213** (per the roadmap-deps block — verify at Solutioning).
Relates to: **#149** (Stage 6 def), **#61** (decomposition protocol), **#288** (sub-task API). Scope-boundary: owns the threshold, not #288's API.
